dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: This place reminds me of the study Miss Lisa set up for me when I was learning to read and write.

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: She said that human writing needs to be appreciated slowly and with a calm mind, so it's important to shut out all noise. When I was in that study, I felt like I could sit and read forever.

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: Ah, honestly, I'm still learning. Would it be alright with you if I come here whenever I want to read?
